title: MECH-X4
description: Ryan Walker mysteriously awakens MECH-X4, a giant robot built to defend Bay City against impending doom. When monsters begin to descend, Ryan recruits his two best friends and his brother to help pilot the robot that is their only hope of saving their town from mass destruction.

episodes_data.title: MECH-X4 1x1
episodes_data.description: Four teen boys use a giant robot to protect their city from danger. In the opener, a high school freshman discovers he has the ability to control technology with his mind and his power awakens MECH-X4, a giant fighting robot.

episodes_data.title: MECH-X4 1x2
episodes_data.description: Ryan Walker, a freshman at Bay City High, has technopathy – the extraordinary ability to control technology with his mind. His talent mysteriously awakens the giant robot, MECH-X4.

episodes_data.title: MECH-X4 1x3
episodes_data.description: When an ooze-infected Harris starts turning into a monster, the team goes on a mission to find a cure.

episodes_data.title: MECH-X4 1x4
episodes_data.description: Ryan uses his "technopathic" powers to access a powerful laser for the team to use and crack open the captive monster’s heart.

episodes_data.title: MECH-X4 1x5
episodes_data.description: Harris convinces Ryan to join a skate competition, meanwhile, an upgraded flying Jaguasaur is deployed to lure the team and MECH-X4 into action.

episodes_data.title: MECH-X4 1x6
episodes_data.description: Principal Grey sets a trap for Ryan, Harris and Spyder while they’re on a camping trip, which leaves MECH-X4 and Mark in danger.

episodes_data.title: MECH-X4 1x7
episodes_data.description: Ryan and the team must rescue Mark and reclaim their robot before it's destroyed.

episodes_data.title: MECH-X4 1x8
episodes_data.description: Ryan and the guys reluctantly join forces with an enemy to try and defeat a greater threat.

episodes_data.title: MECH-X4 1x9
episodes_data.description: Ryan's inner turmoil over a shocking personal revelation causes his power to short circuit, endangering the city.

episodes_data.title: MECH-X4 1x10
episodes_data.description: The team follows clues to Leo's last known location and find themselves facing unexpected threats from a prototype version of Mech-X4.

episodes_data.title: MECH-X4 1x11
episodes_data.description: As Harris' experiment at the science fair goes haywire with potentially explosive consequences, the school's MECH-X4 fan club threatens to uncover Ryan's secret identity.

episodes_data.title: MECH-X4 1x12
episodes_data.description: On the robot's first ever deep-sea mission, Ryan and the team discover the terrifying truth behind the monsters.

episodes_data.title: MECH-X4 1x13
episodes_data.description: With help from his team and a dangerous new technology, Ryan goes on a mission into the mind of his enemy.

episodes_data.title: MECH-X4 1x14
episodes_data.description: The MECH-X4 team sets out to stop the villain's final plan before it can start.

episodes_data.title: MECH-X4 1x15
episodes_data.description: Now considered a danger, the guys and MECH-X4 must dodge authorities while trying to fight a monster unlike any other before.

episodes_data.title: MECH-X4 1x16
episodes_data.description: With the fate of Bay City at stake, Ryan and the team fight to end the monster threat once and for all.
